user.title: Android Meter
user.description: Name the meter the phone will watch.

pair.title: Pair the phone
pair.description:
**Pair the phone with this code**

1. On the phone, open the camera app and point it at the QR code below.
2. Tap **Share** on the text the camera shows and pick **Android Meter**. If the camera only offers Copy, copy it, open Android Meter and press **Paste the pairing link**.
3. Android Meter asks whether to send the pictures to this Home Assistant. Check the address and tap **Use it**.

To type the address instead: `{webhook_url}`

No code below means Home Assistant does not know its address on your network: set it in Settings > System > Network, then find the code in Configure > Phone and pairing.

The phone must be on the same network as Home Assistant. Once the first picture has arrived, press **Set the crop** in Android Meter, then **Find the counter**, and teach the reading. The meter's device page has the same settings as controls, next to the Frame image, for fine tuning.

teach.title: Teach the reading

data_description.reading: Every drum of the meter, decimals included, with a point or a comma before the decimals.
data_description.forget: Start learning again, for instance after a wrong reading was taught. Changing the crop forgets them anyway.

phone.title: Phone and pairing
phone.description: To pair a phone, scan the pairing code below with its camera app and share the text to Android Meter. The phone posts to `{webhook_url}`. No code below means Home Assistant does not know its address on your network: set it in Settings > System > Network.

data_description.qr_code: Scan with the phone's camera app, then share the text to Android Meter. It holds this Home Assistant's address.
data_description.interval: How long the phone waits between two pictures.
data_description.torch: Light the meter for each picture.
data_description.max_flow: The most the meter can pass. 6 m³/h for a G4 meter, 10 for a G6. Readings that would need more are refused.

error.bad_reading: This is not a reading. Type the drums as digits, with a point or a comma before the decimals: the crop has {digits} drums, {decimals} of them decimal, so a reading ends like {example}.
error.crop_outside: The crop goes past the edge of the picture shown.
error.no_crop: Set the crop before teaching a reading.
error.no_frame: No picture was shown to teach the reading from: none has come yet, or the Frame image is disabled. An image just enabled shows about 30 seconds later. Once one shows, type the reading it shows.
error.nothing_at_rest: No drum shows a whole digit on the picture shown. Wait for the meter to stop and try again.
error.no_reading: Type the reading the picture shows, or tick Forget the digits learnt.

abort.not_loaded: The meter is not running. Check the integration and try again.
